We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You close by heading back to the machines—it sounds like a practical exchange that respects your production time matters. We want a competitive price supported by workable delivery commitments. How could flexibility on lead time help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. In doing so, we have already taken that volume change data into account, and we have already taken that should cost data into account.

Our offer is a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

As alternatives, we can offer a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW at our standard terms. 

We welcome the prospect of a long-term partnership and the confirmed volume of 6,000 units per year. We can offer a revised price of €15.50 per unit, provided we maintain our standard 45-day lead time to avoid expedited production costs. Could you please share the details of your should-cost estimate so we can better understand your target? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Please note that material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
